title: Export Contacts
text:
## Export Contacts
Link: https://support.brilliantdirectories.com/support/solutions/articles/12000057105
Once the users of the site register for the newsletter, the admin can export a list of members that have successfully registered on the site. There are associated reasons for doing this, such as marketing campaigns, promos, etc.
To get started navigate to Emails >> View Contacts >> Once in the contact list, at the top right corner will be the " Export Contact Results" button:
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12180358566/original/cSY0Q46m5Z8FkYxW-zlbu3GNbzU4S8Ng_A.png?1781314099 | alt: ]
After clicking the Export button, click on "Yes, continue" to confirm the export:
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12180358564/original/LvBXo-klaVZxs_-4TFutvJxQo2P4uNcwmg.png?1781314077 | alt: ]
Finally, a CSV file with the member's information will be downloaded to the browser:
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12145529638/original/lYlcL4_I5vUdr33xRFRNHRfjt66t5M0Yrw.png?1719524088 | alt: ]
